clauses.scope_note: Section 13: applies to use of Alibaba Cloud-provided products or services and to providing controlled products, technology, software, or services through them; the latter restriction has an exception where the relevant competent-authority permission has been obtained.
clauses.condition_explanation: military_or_wmd_related_user_or_purpose means use for military or weapons-of-mass-destruction-related users or purposes. use_prohibited_by_applicable_export_or_sanctions_law means a use prohibited by applicable export-control or sanctions laws. provide_controlled_item_to_prohibited_destination_person_or_entity_without_required_authorization means providing a controlled product, technology, software, or service through the Alibaba Cloud product or service to a destination, entity, or person prohibited under applicable law without permission from the competent authority. The agreement also commits both parties to comply with applicable export-control and sanctions laws.

obligation_items.content: Do not use Alibaba Cloud-provided products or services for military or weapons-of-mass-destruction-related users or purposes, or for uses prohibited by applicable export-control or sanctions laws.
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever using the products or services.

obligation_items.content: Do not provide controlled products, technology, software, or services through Alibaba Cloud products or services to a destination, entity, or person prohibited by applicable export-control or sanctions laws unless permission from the relevant competent authority has been obtained.
obligation_items.object: Controlled products, technology, software, or services provided through Alibaba Cloud products or services
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever the proposed provision is to a prohibited destination, entity, or person; the restriction does not apply if the required competent-authority permission has been obtained.

clauses.scope_note: Section 14.1.1: this is a customer duty associated with use of Alibaba Cloud services. Contact details include email, telephone, and address; non-natural-person customers must also provide contact details for personnel managing the account and cloud services. The account receiving messages also counts as a contact method.
clauses.condition_explanation: provide_true_effective_contact_details_and_keep_them_current_and_reachable means supplying true, effective contact details, promptly updating changed details, and remaining reachable.

obligation_items.content: Provide true, effective contact details, including email, telephone, and address; if the customer is not a natural person, also provide contact details for personnel managing its Alibaba Cloud account and cloud services; promptly update changed details and remain reachable.
obligation_items.object: Customer contact details and, for a non-natural-person customer, contact details of account and cloud-service administrators
obligation_items.trigger: While using Alibaba Cloud services and whenever contact details change.

clauses.scope_note: Section 14.1.4: separate express assurance to maintain accurate and effective contact information and update it in real time; failure may make legal documents undeliverable or delayed, with resulting legal consequences borne by the customer.
clauses.condition_explanation: contact_details_are_accurate_effective_and_updated_in_real_time means ensuring the supplied contact details are accurate and effective and updating them in real time.

obligation_items.content: Ensure supplied contact details are accurate and effective and update them in real time.
obligation_items.object: Contact details supplied to Alibaba Cloud
obligation_items.trigger: While using Alibaba Cloud services and whenever the supplied contact details change.

clauses.scope_note: Section 14.2.3: duties apply to whichever party is affected by a force majeure or accidental event; they are not limited to the customer.
clauses.condition_explanation: force_majeure_or_accidental_event_affects_party_performance means such an event affects the party's ability to perform all or part of its obligations. The evidence deadline is 15 days after the event; resumption is required as soon as possible within the feasible scope.

obligation_items.content: Take appropriate measures to reduce or eliminate the event's effects and, to the extent possible, resume the affected obligations as soon as possible.
obligation_items.object: Performance of that party's affected contractual obligations
obligation_items.trigger: After a force majeure or accidental event affects performance.

obligation_items.content: Immediately notify the counterparty of the event.
obligation_items.object: Notice to the counterparty concerning the force majeure or accidental event
obligation_items.trigger: When the party encounters the event.

obligation_items.content: Provide the counterparty necessary and reasonable supporting documents and explain the reasons for failure or delay in performing all or part of the obligations.
obligation_items.object: Supporting documents and explanation concerning affected obligations
obligation_items.trigger: Within 15 days after the force majeure or accidental event.

clauses.scope_note: Section 14.2.4: inability to perform all or part of the agreement due to force majeure lasting at least 60 days triggers consultation. If the parties fail to agree on continued-performance conditions within 30 days after consultation begins, either party may terminate by notice.
clauses.condition_explanation: force_majeure_prevents_all_or_part_of_performance_for_at_least_60_days means the event has prevented a party from performing some or all contractual obligations continuously for 60 days or more. Termination by notice is available only if the parties have not agreed on continued-performance conditions within 30 days from the start of consultation.

obligation_items.content: Consult to determine conditions for continuing performance or whether to terminate the agreement.
obligation_items.object: Conditions for continued performance or termination of the agreement
obligation_items.trigger: When force majeure has prevented all or part of a party's performance for at least 60 days.

clauses.scope_note: Section 14.4.2: changes generally take effect upon notification or publication, or on a stated effective date; mandatory legal or regulatory requirements may provide otherwise. The customer may stop using the services and notify Alibaba Cloud to terminate, but must migrate its business data itself. Continued use is treated as acceptance of the changes.
clauses.condition_explanation: customer_disagrees_with_notified_or_published_agreement_or_rule_change means the customer does not agree with an amendment to the agreement or business rules notified or published by Alibaba Cloud. stop_using_services_notify_aliyun_to_terminate_and_migrate_business_data is the stated alternative to continued use. continue_using_services_and_accept_change means continuing service use after the change takes effect.

obligation_items.content: Notify Alibaba Cloud to terminate the service and migrate its business data out if the customer rejects the change and chooses to stop using the services.
obligation_items.object: Termination notice and customer business data
obligation_items.trigger: If the customer disagrees with the change and elects to stop using the services.

clauses.scope_note: Section 14.4.4: the customer may not transfer or otherwise assign all or part of the agreement to any third party, including an affiliate, without Alibaba Cloud's prior written consent. Alibaba Cloud's own transfer to an affiliate is separately allowed after advance notice.
clauses.condition_explanation: aliyun_prior_written_consent means Alibaba Cloud has provided prior written consent to the customer's transfer. Sublicense is used here only as the closest available activity for the agreement-transfer restriction; the clause concerns assignment of contractual rights or obligations, not a grant to sublicense the service or artifact.

obligation_items.content: Do not transfer or otherwise assign all or any part of the agreement to a third party, including an affiliate, without Alibaba Cloud's prior written consent.
obligation_items.object: The agreement and its contractual rights or obligations
obligation_items.trigger: Any proposed transfer or assignment; the restriction does not apply if Alibaba Cloud has given prior written consent.

clauses.scope_note: Section 14.4.10: customer authorizes Alibaba Cloud to display the customer's name and trademarks and the agreement project as a success case in information displays, marketing, and business-opportunity negotiations with potential customers, subject to the agreement's intellectual-property and confidentiality terms.
clauses.condition_explanation: comply_with_agreement_intellectual_property_and_confidentiality_terms means the authorized display or use must not breach the agreement's intellectual-property or confidentiality provisions.
